description:
pkix-path/src/lib.rs has three map().unwrap_or() chains that clippy pedantic (map_unwrap_or) says should be map_or():

1. Line 1217-1221: .rposition(|&b| b != b' ').map(|i| start + i + 1).unwrap_or(start)
   Fix: .rposition(|&b| b != b' ').map_or(start, |i| start + i + 1)

2. Line 1474: rest.split_once('@').map(|(_, h)| h).unwrap_or(rest)
   Fix: rest.split_once('@').map_or(rest, |(_, h)| h)

3. Line 1994: san.as_ref().map(|s| !s.0.is_empty()).unwrap_or(false)
   Fix: san.as_ref().is_some_and(|s| !s.0.is_empty())   (or map_or)

Also in pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs line 124-125: .map(|bc| bc.ca).unwrap_or(false)
   Fix: .map_or(false, |bc| bc.ca)   (or .is_some_and(|bc| bc.ca))

These are readability improvements; no behavior change.
title: map().unwrap_or() pattern should use map_or() — 3 sites in pkix-path
